records.user: In at most two sentences, explain how a checklist can help someone avoid missing steps.
records.rubric: Relevant simple explanation of external memory/visible steps; no repetition, irrelevant clarification or claim that work was performed.

result.assistant_text: A checklist can help someone avoid missing steps by first identifying what is needed and then checking that the items are available. It can also help to record the steps in a way that someone else can follow, so the person checking can see the process without assuming it. If the checklist is meant to guide a decision, it can use the same structure as the original. Once the steps are checked, a brief note can explain the result without implying that the process is complete.
